AI-flagged completeness notes from extraction: Heading styles vary significantly across the module text: some sections use 'TOPIC:' and 'SUB-TOPIC:' explicit prefixes, while materials like 'PLASTICS' and 'OTHER MATERIALS' appear without the explicit 'TOPIC:' prefix, though they share equal structural weighting and competency declarations. In GRAPHICS, the topic overview explicitly mentions four sub-topics (Drafting Aids, Plane Geometry, Symbols, and CAD), but only 'PLANE GEOMETRY' contains detailed text content in this document fragment.

subject.name: Design and Technology
subject.description: Design and Technology syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: MATERIALS
topics.description: Covers the fundamental materials used in Design and Technology, including their properties, production, practical applications, environmental impacts, and safe usage in manufacturing products.

sub_topics.name: MATERIALS-MANUFACTURED BOARDS
sub_topics.description: Focuses on utilizing manufactured boards in product making using tools for measuring, marking, cutting, testing, finishing, and applying edge treatments.

competencies.description: Utilise manufactured boards in different situations

sub_topics.name: MATERIALS – METAL
sub_topics.description: Covers properties and classification of metals, iron and steel production, non-ferrous extraction, practical fabrication, environmental impacts, recycling, and workshop safety.

sub_topics.name: PLASTICS
sub_topics.description: Explores plastic identification, physical and mechanical properties, chemical structure, forming processes, tool manipulation, environmental impacts, practical applications, safety protocols, and conservation strategies.

sub_topics.name: OTHER MATERIALS
sub_topics.description: Examines non-traditional materials such as reed, grass, leather, glass, ceramics, canvas, rubber, and fiberglass, focusing on their properties, environmental effects, tool manipulation, safety, and sustainable reuse.

competencies.description: Utilise other materials in different situations

topics.name: GRAPHICS
topics.description: Covers basic knowledge, skills, values, and attitudes on graphical communication to effectively convey ideas and concepts using internationally recognized symbols and drawings.

sub_topics.name: PLANE GEOMETRY
sub_topics.description: Focuses on the study of shapes, sizes, and positions of objects on a flat surface, including constructing, inscribing, and circumscribing triangles and quadrilaterals for product designs.

topics.name: ENERGY
topics.description: Focuses on energy sources used to power daily life in homes, workplaces, and industries, categorizing them into renewable and non-renewable energy sources.

sub_topics.name: SOURCES OF ENERGY
sub_topics.description: Covers identifying, classifying, analyzing advantages and disadvantages, and designing systems to harness various renewable and non-renewable energy sources.

topics.name: STRUCTURES
topics.description: Examines different types of structures that provide support, stability, and functionality to products, buildings, and engineering systems.

sub_topics.name: STRUCTURES
sub_topics.description: Focuses on identifying and classifying natural, artificial, frame, shell, and mass structures, researching their properties, analyzing causes of structural failure, and applying structural design principles.

competencies.description: Apply knowledge on structures in different situations

topics.name: MECHANISMS
topics.description: Focuses on mechanical systems and motion analysis, allowing product designers to predict mechanism performance, speed, acceleration, and efficiency.

sub_topics.name: MOTIONS
sub_topics.description: Covers identifying, analyzing, sketching, and applying four primary types of motion—linear, rotary, reciprocating, and oscillating—in product design and mechanical development.

topics.name: ENTREPRENEURSHIP
topics.description: Provides guidance on organizing business information to evaluate commercial viability and develop a comprehensive business plan for managing successful ventures.

sub_topics.name: BUSINESS PLAN
sub_topics.description: Focuses on understanding and formulating the key components of a business plan, including executive summary, business description, and marketing plan elements like product description, pricing, target selection, sales strategies, and advertising.
